inlines.v: REMI'SE, verb transitive s as z. [Latin remissus, remitto; re and mitto, to send.] To give or grant back; to release a claim; to resign or surrender by deed. A B hath remised, released, and forever quitclaimed to B C, all his right to the manor of Dale.
